setspec.lessonname: World History OpenStax Volume 1 Chapter 1 Terms

unit.unitinstructions:
World History OpenStax Volume 1 Chapter 1 Terms

This tutor practices 18 key terms from OpenStax World History Volume 1, to 1500, Chapter 1. Each card gives you a textbook glossary definition, and you type the matching world history term from memory.

  • What you will do: Read the definition and enter the exact key term it describes.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback connects the definition to the correct term, while adaptive scheduling brings uncertain terms back sooner.
  • Study tip: Watch for ancient-world vocabulary about civilizations, writing systems, political organization, belief systems, and social structure.

Source and attribution: This flashcard deck is adapted from OpenStax, World History Volume 1, to 1500, Chapter 1 Key Terms, by Ann Kordas, Ryan J. Lynch, Brooke Nelson, and Julie Tatlock. Access the source for free at OpenStax; book URL: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/1-introduction.
